embed.title: !lure
embed.description: Alerts for lure modules placed at pokestops.

fields.name: Lure types
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}lure normal` — standard Lure Module
`{{prefix}}lure glacial`
`{{prefix}}lure mossy`
`{{prefix}}lure magnetic`
`{{prefix}}lure rainy`
`{{prefix}}lure golden` (also `sparkly`)
`{{prefix}}lure mossy glacial` — several types, one rule each
`{{prefix}}lure everything` — any lure

fields.name: Where
fields.value:
With neither `d:` nor `area:`, your `{{prefix}}area` list is used (unless your admin set a default distance).
`d:500` — within that many metres of your location
`location:home d:500` — measured from a saved location (`{{prefix}}help location`)
`area:city_centre` — only these areas instead of your list; several: `area:north,south`. Can't be combined with `d:`

fields.name: Options
Remove
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}lure remove mossy`
`{{prefix}}lure remove everything`
`{{prefix}}lure remove id:12` — one rule; `{{prefix}}tracked` shows the ids
